% A test for tex8web: font commands that the PDF keeps in a group, which
% the page keeps there too: a \contentsname's (a template's, centered in
% small capitals), and an \intertext's.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\renewcommand\contentsname{\hspace*{\fill}\normalfont\scshape Table of Contents\hspace*{\fill}}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\section{Introduction}
The text, in its own font.
\begin{align*}
    a &= b \\
    \intertext{A note, \itshape partly in italics.}
    c &= d \\
    \intertext{Another note.}
    e &= f
\end{align*}
\end{document}
